sources.facts: Describes an Ethereum options protocol and links canonical ACO documentation; supplies no historical ACOWriter deployment address or incident date.
Names LiquidityMigrationV2, reports April10 without timezone, identifies its address and describes amount-based migration. Neither rendering establishes an explicit chain or UTC execution day.

Reports realized CF-token transfers without authorization, identifies the CF contract through a BscScan address link, and attributes the loss to publicly callable transfer internals after the whitelist was disabled. Publication date is not an execution date.

Identifies the original Reserve event, later retired-Reserve events, and three named treasury addresses. Updates extend into August; the full article is not a snapshot of the original incident-day population.
